# Monocypher 4.0.3

Unmodified source from upstream release 4.0.3, commit
`ab2b16dd619ad5f6979a4fbe69cfa324a6fcc35f`.
Archive: https://github.com/LoupVaillant/Monocypher/releases/download/4.0.3/monocypher-4.0.3.tar.gz
Archive SHA-256: `8cc9bc341a66249016db9bd70e9142d8d0aef9945973744b1ac05dbc55d8ee66` (940390 bytes).

The core and optional Ed25519/SHA-512 module implement standard Ed25519.
TostonSync uses the BSD-2-Clause option; the complete dual-license text is
in LICENCE.md. Historical independent review of Monocypher does not establish
an independent audit of this exact integration or of release 4.0.3. This
version includes the upstream EdDSA/Ed25519 timing-leak correction.

Sources: https://monocypher.org/bugs and https://monocypher.org/manual/ed25519 .
